Phew Joe Watson said with surprise. What is it Joe? said his sister Clara. Joe was reading a letter. she asked I hope it isn't about Dad's business and bad news.

Joew says well it is not like trouble but is does have significance. It looks like I am not going to be playing baseball here next year. Oh no Joe said Clara thats horrible. You just helped them witn the penant. I cannot believe that the sport people would treat you like that.

Clara I can't believe you talk like that. Of course women talk like this.

Joe said I guess i will make some money using that arm of mine. Just as he was rearing back his arm Mrs. Johnson came out with a jug to water plants. Joe hit the jug and it fell on the floor. Joe are you ok? I am glad I didn't bring a good jug.

Well this letter I got from Mr. Gregory says that I am going to be drafted by St. Louis. The team (his minor league team forgot name) has the rights to me.

Clara said Oh my you are going to the big leagues? Well I am negotiating said joe.
